ABOUT US

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.






ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Software Engineer, Mission Execution, you'll build the software backbone that carries mission plans from the planner to the field. You'll own the infrastructure that executes missions on autonomous robots and multi-agent systems. You'll work closely with the Mission Planning engineer, simulation engineers and product teams to make sure our systems are reliable, testable, and predictable in live operations.




RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Design and build the mission execution infrastructure that turns planned missions into reliable, real-time behavior across fleets of autonomous systems.

 - Develop scalable backend services and APIs for mission guidance, orchestration, agents communication, and execution.

 - Set and defend a high quality bar: CI/CD pipelines, testing, code review standards, observability, and release discipline.

 - Write production-grade C++ and Python that runs in real-time and resource-constrained environments.

 - Partner with Mission Planning, and product teams to ensure algorithms are integrated cleanly, tested thoroughly, and deployable in the field.

 - Analyze logs and telemetry from tests and live operations to find failure modes and drive systemic fixes.




CANDIDATE REQUIREMENTS

 - Education: M.S. or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Robotics, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

 - Technical skills: Strong coding in C++ and Python, with solid software engineering fundamentals (system design, concurrency, testing, debugging).

 - Experience building and shipping production software: Ideally with distributed or real-time systems.

 - Nice to have: Experience in robotics, embedded software, or video game development (game engines, simulation, deterministic replay, tooling). Experience in aerospace or defense. Familiarity with simulation frameworks.

 - Mindset: Strong communication skills, Rigor, ownership, and a strong instinct for quality.

 - Commitment: 100% dedication to Harmattan AI's mission, vision, and ambitious growth plans, ready to go the extra mile to ensure operational excellence.





We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

Robotics Software Engineer
Full-time | Sunnyvale, CA | Engineering (Onsite)
About Noble Machines
Noble Machines builds multipurpose robots to support human workers in the world's toughest jobs—turning dangerous work from a necessity into a choice. Our work demands reliability, robustness, and readiness for the unexpected—on time, every time. We're assembling a mission-driven team focused on delivering real impact in heavy industry, from construction and mining to energy. If you're driven to build rugged, reliable products that solve real-world problems, we'd love to talk.
Position Overview
As a Robotics Software Engineer, you will work closely with senior engineers to bring hardware prototypes to life and build essential software tools that support our robotic platforms. In this hands-on role, you will assist in integrating new hardware components, developing diagnostic and control interfaces, and maintaining ROS 2 nodes. If you enjoy working with physical systems, writing practical C++ and Python code, and building usable tools across hardware-software boundaries, this role offers an exciting opportunity to grow your technical skills on real-world systems.
Responsibilities
Integrate new hardware prototypes with the robot’s software systems.
Rapidly develop proof-of-concept software for evaluating new components and designs.
Build control, configuration, visualization, and diagnostic GUIs for engineers and operators.
Create reusable tools for hardware bring-up, testing, calibration, data collection, and troubleshooting.
Develop and maintain ROS 2 nodes, interfaces, drivers, and supporting applications.
Work with hardware engineers to define software interfaces and translate prototype requirements into working systems.
Test integrated hardware/software behavior, analyze logs and telemetry, and diagnose issues across subsystem boundaries.
Improve successful prototypes into reliable, documented, and maintainable engineering tools.
Contribute to automated testing, simulation, deployment infrastructure, and other robotics software projects as priorities require.
Participate in design discussions, code reviews, documentation, and field or lab testing.
Requirements
0–2 years of experience in robotics software, embedded systems, or hands-on engineering projects.
Practical C++ and Python ability.
Software fundamentals and debugging skills.
Comfort working with physical systems and imperfect prototypes.
Some ROS or robotics project experience, without requiring deep ROS 2/DDS expertise.
Familiarity with common communication interfaces or protocols—such as CAN, serial, Ethernet, or USB—if those match the hardware.
Ability to build simple user-facing tools or GUIs.
A bias toward experimentation, iteration, and completing usable prototypes.
Clear communication with engineers from different disciplines.
Nice to Have
Hands-on experience with hardware bring-up, microcontroller development, or sensor integration.
Familiarity with simulation environments (Gazebo, Isaac Sim, MuJoCo) or containerization (Docker).
Educational background or degree in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field.
Open-source contributions or personal robotics projects.
